item.title: Bone and Biscuit Best Buddy – Feb 4 – Floofers and Ewok
item.description: Meet Floofers and Ewok, two inseparable brothers and the last of their litter to find a family of their own. These boys have been bonded since day one and must be adopted together. They are never far apart, always seeking each other out for playtime and snuggles, and if one is out of sight the other will call out until they’re back together again. item.title: This Week in the Peace – Ducks Unlimited & The Crystal Cup
item.description: Today on This Week in the Peace, Bruce Harrison from Ducks Unlimited checks in to talk about the situation unfolding with the future of Inga Lake as the dam desperately needs repair but there's no funding in place to do so. Then, Neil Evans has been meticulously organizing this year's edition of the Crystal Cup, so he'll stop by to tell us all about the annual pond hockey tournament happening on Charlie Lake from February 20-22.
